_about: The day's note and the video of it. index.html reads this. Written by the screen run; ranks are from the file the note was written from, never today's. Set orientation to 'vertical' only when the upload really is a 9:16 cut.
blurb: Yelp fell 6.5% through its 52-week low and moved up the ranking, because cheapness carries four times the weight of the market's opinion. What the screen likes in each of the five, and what it doesn't.
